user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents, extract text using OCR, store documents securely, provide semantic search and question answering using RAG, support user authentication, and expose APIs for integration with other enterprise systems. Prefer reusable open-source solutions where appropriate, but ensure the selected components have suitable licenses and acceptable security/maturity.
normalized_request: Enterprise AI document intelligence platform enabling PDF upload, OCR-based text extraction, secure document storage, semantic search with RAG-based question answering, user authentication, and REST APIs for third-party integration.

requirements.description: Support secure PDF document upload from authenticated users with validation and virus scanning
Extract text from PDF documents using OCR with support for scanned and digital PDFs
Store documents and extracted metadata securely with encryption at rest and in transit
Enable semantic search across document collections using vector embeddings
Provide question answering capability using RAG to retrieve relevant document sections and generate answers
Authenticate users and manage access control to documents and platform features
Expose REST APIs for document ingestion, search, QA, and system integration with third-party applications
Monitor system health, performance, and usage metrics with observability and logging
Manage user sessions, permissions, and audit trails for compliance and security

components.name: DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_AND_VALIDATION
components.description: Handle secure file upload, format validation, virus scanning, and pre-processing of PDF documents with size/format restrictions

components.name: OCR_AND_TEXT_EXTRACTION
components.description: Extract text from scanned and digital PDFs using optical character recognition and document parsing to produce searchable text content

components.name: DOCUMENT_AND_METADATA_STORAGE
components.description: Store original PDF files and extracted metadata with encryption at rest, supporting versioning and retention policies

components.name: SEMANTIC_SEARCH_AND_RAG
components.description: Generate vector embeddings from extracted text, index for semantic search, and orchestrate retrieval-augmented generation for question answering with context-aware LLM inference

components.name: USER_AUTHENTICATION_AND_AUTHORIZATION
components.description: Manage user identity, access credentials, session tokens, role-based access control, and permission enforcement across platform features

components.name: REST_API_GATEWAY
components.description: Expose RESTful endpoints for document upload, search queries, question answering, and system integration with request validation and rate limiting

components.name: AUDIT_AND_COMPLIANCE_LOG
components.description: Track user actions, document access, API calls, and system events for compliance, security investigation, and user session management

components.name: OBSERVABILITY_AND_MONITORING
components.description: Collect metrics, logs, and traces for system performance, API latency, resource utilization, and alerting on anomalies

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into functional components: PDF upload handling, OCR text extraction, secure document storage, semantic search indexing, RAG-based question answering, user authentication, and API exposure, identifying dependencies and integration points.

Identify open-source and public ecosystem solutions for each component (OCR engines, vector databases, LLM frameworks, authentication systems, API gateways, AWS integrations) that are available on GitHub or established package repositories, documenting license types and maturity indicators.

Assess each identified candidate solution against criteria: license compatibility for enterprise use, security audit trails, production-readiness, AWS native integration, performance benchmarks, and community support maturity.

Determine for each functional component whether to REUSE an existing open-source solution, ADAPT an existing solution with modifications, or BUILD custom code, providing justification based on evaluation results.

Create a detailed architecture blueprint including: AWS service selections, open-source tool integration points, API specifications, data flow diagrams, authentication/authorization design, RAG pipeline configuration, and deployment topology.

Validate the blueprint for technical feasibility, license compliance, security best practices, AWS cost implications, scalability assumptions, and identify any gaps or risks requiring clarification before implementation.
